name: Paneer Xacuti
steps: Dry-roast coconut, chilies, coriander, cumin, poppy seeds, pepper and star anise separately until aromatic and golden, taking care not to burn the coconut.
Cool the spices, remove the star-anise husk, then grind everything with 150 ml water into a fine but textured xacuti paste.
Heat oil and fry onion for 8 minutes until golden. Add the ground paste and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until it darkens and smells nutty.
Add remaining water, tamarind and salt. Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until the roasted-coconut gravy thickens.
Add paneer and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before serving with steamed rice or poi bread.
tips: Roast the coconut to a deep golden shade for xacuti's characteristic dark, nutty sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
